description_en: Queries the association between an asset and an Anti-DDoS Origin instance of a paid edition
description_zh: 查询资产组和防护包实例绑定关系
kebab_example: aliyun ddosbgp describe-asset-group --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --name waf_v2_public_cn-lbj382l0000 --type waf --biz-region cn-hangzhou --api-version 2018-07-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeAssetGroup

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the region in which the instance resides.

> You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/118703.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh:
DDoS原生防护实例所在地域ID。

> 您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/118703.html查询DDoS原生防护支持的所有地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the asset. If the asset is a Web Application Firewall (WAF) instance, specify the ID of the WAF instance
parameters.help_zh: 资产组名称。对于WAF，指WAF的实例ID
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en:
The type of the asset. Valid values:

- **waf**: WAF instance

- **ga**: Global Accelerator (GA) instance
parameters.help_zh:
资产组类型。取值：
- **waf**：表示WAF资产。
- **ga**：表示GA资产
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the asset
parameters.name: region
